Formula / meaning: Loan_Amount ÷ Collateral_Value  (above 1 = loan larger than the asset pledged)
Loan_Amount ÷ Annual_Income  (size of the loan against yearly income)
(Existing_Loan + Loan_Amount) ÷ Annual_Income  (all debt after this loan)
(Loan_Amount ÷ (Loan_Term_Months ÷ 12)) ÷ Annual_Income  (share of yearly income needed just to repay the principal)
